items.t: Hard steering at low speeds from a failing power steering pump
items.job: Replace power steering pump and flush fluid
items.note: If the rack is also leaking, replacing both can run $1,400-1,800.

items.job: Replace power steering rack and pinion
items.note: Includes a wheel alignment afterward in most shops.

items.t: Misfire and surging from failing ignition coils
items.job: Replace ignition coils (all six) and spark plugs
items.note: Replacing one coil costs much less but the others may follow.

items.t: Low-beam headlight burns out repeatedly from melted wiring
items.job: Replace low-beam bulb connector with GM service pigtail (one or both sides)
items.note: GM bulletin 10-08-42-001D lists pigtail 22855316 for the Outlook and 0.8 hr for one side plus 0.6 hr for the other. An earlier bulletin (09-08-42-004) allows 1.3 hr per side for a harness swap. Price is for the connector only; add a new bulb.

items.t: Water leaks from clogged sunroof drains damage electronics
items.job: Clean sunroof drain hoses and reseal the cowl seam
items.note: Based on an owner-reported typical cost of about $200 (CarComplaints). GM bulletin 08-08-57-003 covers drain cleaning and cowl seam sealing but gives no labor time. If water has already damaged the fuse and relay block or other modules, the repair costs much more.
